release_notes: Maintenance Toolkit 4.1.0 adds verified standalone MSI/ZIP self-update with explicit consent, protected opt-in and transactional recovery; SYSTEM scheduling and seven selectable UI languages with partial translations and English fallback. GPO remains detection-only. No automatic restart, BIOS or NVIDIA installation. First upgrade from 4.0.6 is manual.
